segments.text: Meta fields are a flexible way to add and store additional information about Shopify resources such as a customer or company. You can synchronize and then manage meta fields in the business central either via UI or via extensibility model where you can map meta fields
to business central fields or other entities. Let's see the demo. You see the custom data in Shopify being extended by using metap fields.
import that customer from Shopify into Business Central. You can get access to review meta fields from a list where you can open card and the same action is available there as well.

When opened, you can see all meta fields of various types including the one of type customer reference. Developers can map standard or custom fields and related entries in Business Central to Shopify meta fields using an extensibility model.

Code samples are available in the documentation. These fields are non-editable because synchronization is from Shopify. For B2B companies, synchronization is not for all companies and the can update Shopify companies toggle is
on. Data entry can be performed
here. Metap field definitions created by administrators in Shopify are shown in the Shopify company card for easy data
entry. In this release, we can import meta field definitions requiring only the input of necessary data.
The enter data is now available in Shopify. Thank you for watching. You can find more details about capability in the release note. Also watch other videos about enhancements on Shopify connector.
You can find links in the description.
